online_test.description: Raw online test profile at the original frame rate using native association and the Blend50 checkpoint. Scores from offline trajectory processing refer to a separate output protocol.

sparse_val.validation_partition: Use the second half of each FRCNN training sequence (original frames floor(N / 2) + 1 through N, where N is the sequence length). Start stride sampling at the first frame of that half.
sparse_val.description: Sparse validation profile using the shared Full checkpoint and the appearance-expanded gate. Stride 1 is also available for component comparisons.
